maria_sales: Heads up — Prospect MeridiaLabs uploaded a ~180-question security questionnaire into their vendor portal: https://files.meridia.com/q/abc123. They want answers by EOW. Flags: PII handling, encryption, logging. Can someone own and give an ETA?
andrew_ae: Thanks — this is a mid-enterprise deal. Suggest we do a two-stage response: quick high-level answers to keep momentum + full evidence pack. Who can own the technical Qs?
sam_security: I can own the security control matrix and canonical answers, but I’ll need infra details from @tyler_se. With SE + PM support I can have draft answers in ~3 business days. @ana_sec_pm can you handle evidence collection?
tyler_se: I can pull infra config + network diagram. Quick clarifying Q: do they expect KMS/HSM specifics (e.g., rotation schedule, HSM model)? We have standard language but can provide details for dedicated/private. Also will need log retention numbers per account.
nana_sec_pm: @sam_security I’ll assemble policy artifacts (SOC2 link, pen test summary, privacy policy), and help map evidence to SIG/CAIQ controls. I'll also review the final packet.
maria_sales: Great — Andrew, I'll tell them we can deliver initial answers by Thu EOD and the full evidence pack by next Tue. Also confirm whether FIPS/HSM is a hard requirement.
andrew_ae: On it. I’ll ask for scope (prod only vs prod+staging) and whether they want CAIQ JSON/CSV or the PDF. Looping in legal if they require an NDA for docs.
security-bot: :information_source: Reminder: Attach latest pen-test PDF and SOC2 link to the ticket. Evidence path: /sec-evidence/2025/soc2.pdf
tyler_se: ```
Q mapping (quick):
Q 2.1 - Data classification -> Tyler
Q 3.4 - KMS / key rotation -> Tyler
Q 5.2 - App auth & token lifetimes -> Sam
Q 9.0 - Logging / retention -> Sam
```
sam_security: Clarification for KMS: we use AWS KMS with CMKs, rotation policy is 365 days by default. For HSM-level assurance we only provide HSM in Private deployments (requires separate contract). I’ll mark that in the answers as "requires dedicated deployment" where appropriate.
maria_sales: Can we get an estimate of hours so I can scope in SFDC and inform procurement?
nana_sec_pm: Ballpark: drafting answers ~6-8 hrs, evidence collection ~4 hrs, review ~2 hrs => ~12-14 hrs. Add ~4 hrs if they request HSM-specific artifacts or a dedicated runbook.
andrew_ae: Perfect — I’ll update the prospect with that estimate and ask for CSV export of questions if they can.
tyler_se: If they only provide a PDF it'll add ~1-2 hrs parsing + manual mapping. CSV/JSON helps automation.
maria_sales: :thumbsup: I'll ask for CSV and confirm scope. Owner assignment: sam_security primary owner (answers), tyler_se technical author, ana_sec_pm reviewer. I’ll tag this on the opportunity and flag for priority.
security-bot: :white_check_mark: Ticket created: SEC-2387 assigned to sam_security. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2387
maria_sales: Thanks everyone — I’ll follow up once Andrew gets confirmation from Meridia on scope/format. If anyone needs me to reach out to customer directly to unblock, ping me.
